title.zh: 卷四 本紀第四 恭閔帝
title.raw: 卷四 本紀第四 恭閔帝 Volume 4 Annals 4: Emperor Gongming

sentences.zh: 恭閔惠皇帝諱允炆。

translations.literal: Emperor Gongmin the Kind, tabooed name Yunwen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gongmin Hui—Zhu Yunwen—bore the tabooed name Yunwen.

sentences.zh: 太祖孫，懿文太子第二子也。

translations.literal: Grandson of Taizu, second son of heir apparent Yiwen.
translations.idiomatic: He was Taizu's grandson and the second son of the heir apparent Yiwen.

sentences.zh: 母妃呂氏。

translations.literal: His mother was consort Lü.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Consort Lü.

sentences.zh: 帝生潁慧好學，性至孝。

translations.literal: From birth he was sharp-witted and fond of learning; his nature was supremely filial.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood he was keen-witted and devoted to study, and filial piety ran to the marrow of his nature.

sentences.zh: 年十四，待懿文太子疾，晝夜不暫離。

translations.literal: At age fourteen, when attending to heir apparent Yiwen's illness, day and night he did not leave for a moment.
translations.idiomatic: At fourteen, while nursing the heir apparent Yiwen through his illness, he kept his bedside day and night without a single absence.

sentences.zh: 更二年，太子薨，居喪毀瘠。

translations.literal: Two years later the heir apparent died; in mourning he wasted away.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later the heir apparent died, and in mourning he wasted nearly to death.

sentences.zh: 太祖撫之曰：「而誠純孝，顧不念我乎。

translations.literal: Taizu comforted him, saying: "You are truly pure in filial piety—yet do you spare no thought for me?"
translations.idiomatic: Taizu drew him close and said, "Your filial devotion is pure—but have you no room left to think of me?"

sentences.zh: 」洪武二十五年九月，立為皇太孫。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-fifth year of Hongwu, he was established as heir apparent grandson.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Hongwu 25, he was installed as heir apparent grandson.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，重定諸王見東宮儀制，朝見後於內殿行家人禮，以諸王皆尊屬也。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the protocol for princes' audiences with the Eastern Palace was revised: after the court audience they were to perform family rites in the inner hall, because the princes were all senior kin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year the court revised how princes attended the Eastern Palace: after the formal audience they were to observe family courtesy in the inner hall, for the princes were all the heir's senior kin.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖命太子省決章奏，太子性仁厚，於刑獄多所減省。

translations.literal: Initially Taizu had charged the heir apparent to review and decide on memorials and documents; the heir apparent's nature was humane and generous, and in criminal cases he often reduced sentences.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Taizu had set the heir apparent to sift and decide memorials; humane by temperament, the heir often lightened penalties in criminal matters.

sentences.zh: 至是以命太孫，太孫亦復佐以寬大。

translations.literal: Now the same charge was given to the heir apparent grandson, and the heir apparent grandson again assisted with leniency.
translations.idiomatic: The same charge passed to the heir apparent grandson, who again tempered judgment with mercy.

sentences.zh: 嘗請於太祖，遍考禮經，參之歷朝刑法，改定洪武《律》畸重者七十三條，天下莫不頌德焉。

translations.literal: He once petitioned Taizu to examine comprehensively the ritual classics and, consulting punishments of successive dynasties, revise seventy-three articles of the Hongwu Code that were excessively severe; throughout the realm none failed to praise his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: He once asked Taizu to comb the ritual classics and, against the penal codes of past dynasties, soften seventy-three harsh articles of the Hongwu Code; the empire rang with praise.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，召漢中府教授方孝孺為翰林院侍講。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Fang Xiaoru, professor of Hanzhong Prefecture, was summoned as Hanlin Academician Reader-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Fang Xiaoru, professor at Hanzhong Prefecture, was called to serve as Hanlin Reader-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 詔行寬政，赦有罪，蠲逋賦。

translations.literal: An edict enacted lenient government: amnesty for the guilty and remission of overdue taxes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed clemency: criminals were pardoned and arrears in tax forgiven.

sentences.zh: 八月，周王橚有罪，廢為庶人，徙雲南。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Prince of Zhou Zhu Su was guilty of a crime, demoted to commoner, and banished to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Prince Zhou Zhu Su was found guilty, stripped of rank, and exiled to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 詔興州、營州、開平諸衛軍全家在伍者，免一人。

translations.literal: An edict: in the guards of Xingzhou, Yingzhou, and Kaiping, for households with every man in military service, one man was exempted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ruled that in the Xingzhou, Yingzhou, and Kaiping guards, where every male of a household stood on the rolls, one man was to be released.

sentences.zh: 天下衛所軍單丁者，放為民。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm, where guard and battalion soldiers were sole sons, they were released to become civilians.
translations.idiomatic: Across the empire, sole surviving sons in guard and battalion service were discharged to civilian life.

sentences.zh: 九月，雲南總兵官西平侯沐春卒於軍，左副將何福代領其眾。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the regional commander in Yunnan, Western Pacification Marquis Mu Chun, died in camp; left deputy commander He Fu took command of his forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Mu Chun, Marquis of Western Pacification and commander in Yunnan, died on campaign; Deputy Commander He Fu assumed his troops.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，工部侍郎張昺為北平布政使，謝貴、張信掌北平都指揮使司，察燕陰事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Vice Minister of Works Zhang Bing was made Beiping administration commissioner; Xie Gui and Zhang Xin took charge of the Beiping regional military commission, to investigate Yan's secret affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhang Bing, vice minister of works, became Beiping administration commissioner; Xie Gui and Zhang Xin were set over the Beiping regional command to probe Prince Yan's hidden designs.

sentences.zh: 詔求直言，舉山林才德之士。

translations.literal: An edict sought blunt counsel and recommended men of talent and virtue from the mountains and forests.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for unsparing memorials and commended reclusive men of talent and virtue.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，何福破斬刀干孟，麓川平。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the twelfth month, He Fu defeated and beheaded Dao Gan Meng; Lucian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the twelfth month He Fu routed and slew Dao Gan Meng, and Lucian was brought to peace.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜天下明年田租之半，釋黥軍及囚徒還鄉里。

translations.literal: That month, half the next year's land tax was remitted throughout the realm; tattooed soldiers and prisoners were released to return to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: That same month the court remitted half the land tax empire-wide for the coming year and sent branded troops and convicts home.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、占城入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam and Champa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies arrived from Siam and Champa.

sentences.zh: 建文元年春正月癸酉，受朝，不舉樂。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the first year of Jianwen, on the guiyou day, he received court; music was not performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jianwen 1, on guiyou, Jianwen held audience without music.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大祀天地於南郊，奉太祖配。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern altar, with Taizu paired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar, with Taizu enshrined beside him.

sentences.zh: 修《太祖實錄》。

translations.literal: The Veritable Records of Taizu were compiled.
translations.idiomatic: Work began on the Veritable Records of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 二月，追尊皇考曰孝康皇帝，廟號興宗，妣常氏曰孝康皇后。

translations.literal: In the second month, his deceased father was posthumously honored as Emperor Xiaokang, temple name Xingzong; his mother Lady Chang was posthumously honored as Empress Xiaokang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the emperor posthumously honored his father as Emperor Xiaokang, temple name Xingzong, and his mother Lady Chang as Empress Xiaokang.

sentences.zh: 尊母妃呂氏曰皇太后，冊妃馬氏為皇后。

translations.literal: His mother consort Lü was honored as empress dowager; consort Ma was invested as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Lü, his mother, was raised to empress dowager, and Consort Ma was invested as empress.

sentences.zh: 封弟允熥為吳王，允熞衡王，允熙徐王。

translations.literal: His younger brothers Yun Teng were enfeoffed as Prince of Wu, Yun Jie as Prince of Heng, and Yun Xi as Prince of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: His brothers Zhu Yun Teng, Zhu Yun Jie, and Zhu Yun Xi were enfeoffed as princes of Wu, Heng, and Xu.

sentences.zh: 立皇長子文奎為皇太子。

translations.literal: The eldest imperial son Wen Kui was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Wen Kui was installed as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 詔告天下，舉遺賢。

translations.literal: An edict announced to the realm and recommended overlooked worthies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rang through the empire calling for overlooked men of worth.

sentences.zh: 賜民高年米肉絮帛，鰥寡孤獨廢疾者官為牧養。

translations.literal: The people of advanced age were given grain, meat, cotton, and silk; widows, orphans, the solitary, the disabled were to be supported by the state.
translations.idiomatic: The aged received grain, meat, and cloth; widows, orphans, the solitary, and the disabled were placed under official care.

sentences.zh: 重農桑，興學校，考察官吏，振罹災貧民，旌節孝，瘞暴骨，蠲荒田租。

translations.literal: Sericulture was stressed, schools were revived, officials were inspected, the disaster-stricken and poor were relieved, chastity and filial piety were honored, exposed bones were buried, and land tax in famine districts was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The court stressed sericulture, revived schools, inspected officials, relieved the disaster-stricken poor, honored chastity and filial piety, buried the unburied dead, and remitted tax on famine lands.

sentences.zh: 衛所軍戶絕都除勿勾。

translations.literal: Where guard and battalion military households had died out, all were struck from the rolls and no further pursuit was made.
translations.idiomatic: Extinct military-household lines in guards and battalions were struck from the rolls with no further pursuit.

sentences.zh: 詔諸王毋得節制文武吏士，更定內外大小官制。

translations.literal: An edict: the princes were not to control civil and military officials and officers; the inner and outer official systems, great and small, were revised.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade princes to command civil and military officers and reworked the hierarchy of inner and outer offices.

sentences.zh: 三月，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: In the third month, the sacrifice was offered to the First Teacher Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the court offered the sacrifice to Confucius as First Teacher.

sentences.zh: 罷天下諸司不急務。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm, offices' non-urgent duties were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Nonessential business was struck from every office in the realm.

sentences.zh: 都督宋忠、徐凱、耿王瓛帥兵屯開平、臨清、山海關。

translations.literal: Regional commanders Song Zhong, Xu Kai, and Geng Juan led troops stationed at Kaiping, Linqing, and Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders Song Zhong, Xu Kai, and Geng Juan encamped troops at Kaiping, Linqing, and Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 調北平、永清二衛軍於彰德、順德。

translations.literal: The armies of the Beiping and Yongqing guards were transferred to Zhangde and Shunde.
translations.idiomatic: Forces of the Beiping and Yongqing guards were shifted to Zhangde and Shunde.

sentences.zh: 侍郎暴昭、夏原吉等二十四人充採訪使，分巡天下。

translations.literal: Vice Ministers Bao Zhao, Xia Yuanji, and twenty-two others served as touring investigators, patrolling the realm in separate circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Vice ministers Bao Zhao, Xia Yuanji, and twenty-two others were sent as touring investigators to sweep the provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲午，京師地震，求直言。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, the capital shook with earthquake; blunt counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the capital was struck by earthquake, and the emperor again called for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，湘王柏自焚死。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Prince of Xiang Zhu Bai burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Prince Xiang Zhu Bai set himself afire and died.

sentences.zh: 齊王榑、代王桂有罪，廢為庶人。

translations.literal: Prince of Qi Zhu Fu and Prince of Dai Zhu Gui were guilty of crimes and demoted to commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Qi and Dai, Zhu Fu and Zhu Gui, were found guilty and reduced to commoners.

sentences.zh: 遣燕王世子高熾及其弟高煦、高燧還北平。

translations.literal: The heir of Yan, Gao Chi, and his younger brothers Gao Xu and Gao Sui were sent back to Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yan's heir Gao Chi and his brothers Gao Xu and Gao Sui were sent back to Beiping.

sentences.zh: 六月，岷王楩有罪，廢為庶人，徙漳州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Prince of Min Zhu Zhen was guilty of a crime, demoted to commoner, and banished to Zhangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Prince Min Zhu Zhen was stripped of rank and exiled to Zhangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，燕山護衛百主戶倪諒上變，燕旗校於諒等伏誅。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Ni Liang, company commander of the Yanshan guard, submitted a denunciation; Yan's military runners were executed in connection with Liang and the others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Ni Liang, a company commander of the Yanshan guard, laid information against Prince Yan; Yan's military runners implicated with Liang and his party were put to death.

sentences.zh: 詔讓燕王棣，逮王府官僚。

translations.literal: An edict reproached Prince of Yan Zhu Di and ordered the arrest of his household officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Prince Yan Zhu Di and commanded the seizure of his household staff.

sentences.zh: 北平都指揮張信叛附於燕。

translations.literal: Beiping regional commander Zhang Xin rebelled and attached himself to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xin, regional commander of Beiping, turned traitor and joined Prince Yan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，燕王棣舉兵反，殺布政使張昺、都司謝貴。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guiyou day, Prince of Yan Zhu Di raised troops in rebellion and killed administration commissioner Zhang Bing and regional commander Xie Gui.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guiyou, Prince Yan Zhu Di rose in arms, killing Commissioner Zhang Bing and Commander Xie Gui.

sentences.zh: 長史葛誠、指揮盧振、教授余逢辰死之。

translations.literal: Chief steward Ge Cheng, commander Lu Zhen, and reader-in-waiting Yu Fengchen died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Chief steward Ge Cheng, Commander Lu Zhen, and Reader Yu Fengchen died defending the city.

sentences.zh: 參政郭資、副使墨麟、僉事呂震等降於燕。

translations.literal: Administration commissioner Guo Zi, deputy commissioner Mo Lin, assistant commissioner Lü Zhen, and others surrendered to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Guo Zi, Deputy Mo Lin, Assistant Lü Zhen, and others went over to Yan.

sentences.zh: 指揮馬宣走薊州，僉瑱走居庸。

translations.literal: Commander Ma Xuan fled to Ji Prefecture; Commissioner Yu Tan fled to Juyong.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Ma Xuan fled toward Ji Prefecture; Commissioner Yu Tan toward Juyong.

sentences.zh: 宋忠趨北平，聞變退保懷來。

translations.literal: Song Zhong hurried toward Beiping; hearing of the uprising, he withdrew to hold Huailai.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zhong marched on Beiping but, hearing of the revolt, fell back to defend Huailai.

sentences.zh: 通州、遵化、密雲相繼降燕。

translations.literal: Tongzhou, Zunhua, and Miyun surrendered to Yan in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhou, Zunhua, and Miyun fell to Yan one after another.

sentences.zh: 丙子，燕兵陷薊州，馬宣戰死。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Yan's troops took Ji Prefecture; Ma Xuan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Yan's army seized Ji Prefecture; Ma Xuan fell fighting.

sentences.zh: 己卯，燕兵陷居庸關。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, Yan's troops took Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Yan's forces stormed Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 甲申，陷懷來，宋忠、俞瑱被執死，都指揮彭聚、孫泰力戰死，永平指揮使郭亮等叛降燕。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Huailai fell; Song Zhong and Yu Tan were captured and executed; regional commanders Peng Ju and Sun Tai died fighting fiercely; Yongping commander Guo Liang and others rebelled and surrendered to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Huailai was lost; Song Zhong and Yu Tan were taken and killed; Commanders Peng Ju and Sun Tai died in fierce combat; Guo Liang of Yongping and others defected to Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，谷王橞自宣府奔京師。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Prince of Gu Zhu Hui fled from Xuanfu to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Prince Gu Zhu Hui fled Xuanfu for the capital.

sentences.zh: 長興侯耿炳文為征虜大將軍，駙馬都尉李堅、都督甯忠為左、右副將軍，帥師討燕。

translations.literal: Changxing Marquis Geng Bingwen was made Great General for the Punitive Campaign against the Barbarians; imperial son-in-law and commander Li Jian and regional commander Ning Zhong were left and right deputy generals, leading an army to attack Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Changxing Marquis Geng Bingwen was appointed punitive grand general; Li Jian the imperial son-in-law and Commander Ning Zhong served as his deputies, marching to crush Prince Yan.

sentences.zh: 祭告天地宗廟社稷，削燕屬籍。

translations.literal: Sacrifice was announced at the altars of Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain; Yan was struck from the imperial clan registers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reported to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain, and struck Prince Yan from the clan rolls.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「邦家不造，骨肉周親屢謀僭逆。

translations.literal: The edict said: "The state has met misfortune; bone kin of the Zhou lineage have repeatedly plotted usurpation.
translations.idiomatic: The edict ran: "The realm has fallen on evil days; royal kin have again and again conspired treason.

sentences.zh: 去年，周庶人橚僭為不軌，辭連燕、齊、湘三王。

translations.literal: Last year the commoner Zhu Su of Zhou committed unlicensed acts; his confession implicated the three princes of Yan, Qi, and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Last year the deposed Prince Zhou Zhu Su overstepped all bounds, and his confession tied Yan, Qi, and Xiang in the same plot.

sentences.zh: 朕以親親故，止正橚罪。

translations.literal: I, considering the bond of kin, punished only Su's crime.
translations.idiomatic: Out of kinship I punished Su alone.

sentences.zh: 今年齊王榑謀逆，又與棣、柏同謀，柏伏罪自焚死，榑已廢為庶人。

translations.literal: This year Prince of Qi Zhu Fu plotted rebellion, again conspiring with Di and Bai; Bai met guilt and burned himself to death; Fu has already been demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: This year Prince Qi Zhu Fu plotted rebellion with Prince Yan and Prince Xiang; Xiang answered for his guilt in fire; Fu is already a commoner.

sentences.zh: 朕以棣於親最近，未忍窮治其事。

translations.literal: I, considering that Di is the nearest in kin, did not yet exhaust the matter in investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yan stands closest in blood, and I had not yet pressed the inquiry to its end.

sentences.zh: 今乃稱兵構亂，圖危宗社，獲罪天地祖宗，義不容赦。

translations.literal: Now he has raised troops and fomented disorder, plotting to endanger the altars of state; he has incurred guilt before Heaven and Earth and the ancestors—by righteousness he cannot be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Now he has taken up arms and stirred rebellion, scheming against the altars of state; he has offended Heaven, Earth, and the ancestors, and righteousness will not spare him.

sentences.zh: 是用簡發大兵，往致厥罰。

translations.literal: Therefore a great army is being selected and sent to inflict its punishment.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore marshal a great host to visit punishment upon him.

sentences.zh: 咨爾中外臣民軍士，各懷忠守義，與國同心，掃茲逆氛，永安至治。

translations.literal: I charge you, civil and military officials and soldiers within and without, each to harbor loyalty and uphold righteousness, join heart with the state, sweep away this rebellious miasma, and secure enduring peace.
translations.idiomatic: To every officer and soldier, within the court and without: hold fast to loyalty, stand with the throne, scour away this treason, and settle the realm in lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 」尋命安陸侯吳傑，江陰侯吳高，都督耿瓛，都指揮盛庸、潘忠、楊松、顧成、徐凱、李友、陳暉、平安，分道併進。

translations.literal: Soon after, Anlu Marquis Wu Jie, Jiangyin Marquis Wu Gao, regional commander Geng Juan, commanders Sheng Yong, Pan Zhong, Yang Song, Gu Cheng, Xu Kai, Li You, Chen Hui, and Ping An were ordered to advance by separate routes in concert.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wu Jie of Anlu, Wu Gao of Jiangyin, Commander Geng Juan, and the commanders Sheng Yong, Pan Zhong, Yang Song, Gu Cheng, Xu Kai, Li You, Chen Hui, and Ping An were ordered to advance on converging routes.

sentences.zh: 置平燕布政使司於真定，尚書暴昭掌司事。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commission for Yan was established at Zhending; Minister Bao Zhao directed its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: A Pacification Commission for Yan was set up at Zhending under Minister Bao Zhao.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，耿炳文兵次真定，徐凱屯河間，潘忠、楊松屯鄚州。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Geng Bingwen's army halted at Zhending; Xu Kai encamped at Hejian; Pan Zhong and Yang Song encamped at Mozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the eighth month Geng Bingwen halted at Zhending; Xu Kai at Hejian; Pan Zhong and Yang Song at Mozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，燕兵陷雄縣，潘忠、楊松戰於月漾橋，被執。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Yan's troops took Xiong County; Pan Zhong and Yang Song fought at Moon-ripple Bridge and were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yan's army took Xiong County; at Moon-ripple Bridge Pan Zhong and Yang Song were defeated and seized.

sentences.zh: 鄚州陷。

translations.literal: Mozhou fell.
translations.idiomatic: Mozhou fell.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，耿炳文及燕兵戰於滹沱河北，敗績，李堅、甯忠、顧成被執，炳文退保真定。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, Geng Bingwen fought Yan's troops north of the Hutuo River, suffered defeat; Li Jian, Ning Zhong, and Gu Cheng were captured; Bingwen withdrew to hold Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Geng Bingwen met Yan's host north of the Hutuo and was broken; Li Jian, Ning Zhong, and Gu Cheng were taken; Bingwen fell back on Zhending.

sentences.zh: 燕兵攻之不克，引去。

translations.literal: Yan's troops attacked but could not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's army assaulted the city without success and drew off.

sentences.zh: 召遼王植、寧王權歸京師，權不至，詔削護衛。

translations.literal: Princes of Liao and Ning, Zhu Zhi and Zhu Quan, were summoned to the capital; Quan did not come, and an edict stripped his guard troops.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Liao and Ning, Zhu Zhi and Zhu Quan, were recalled to court; Quan refused to come, and an edict stripped his guard.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，曹國公李景隆為征虜大將軍，代耿炳文。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, Cao State Duke Li Jinglong was made Great General for the Punitive Campaign against the Barbarians, replacing Geng Bingwen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Cao Duke Li Jinglong replaced Geng Bingwen as punitive grand general.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，吳高、耿瓛、楊文帥遼東兵，圍永平。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the ninth month, Wu Gao, Geng Juan, and Yang Wen led Liaodong troops and besieged Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the ninth month Wu Gao, Geng Juan, and Yang Wen invested Yongping with Liaodong troops.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，景隆兵次河間，燕兵援永平，吳高退保山海關。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Li Jinglong's army halted at Hejian; Yan's troops relieved Yongping, and Wu Gao withdrew to hold Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Jinglong halted at Hejian; Yan marched to relieve Yongping, and Wu Gao fell back on Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，燕兵自劉家口間道襲陷大寧，守將硃鑒死之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Yan's troops by a hidden route through Liujiakou suddenly attacked and took Daning; defending commander Zhu Jian died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Yan's men slipped through Liujiakou by a hidden track, stormed Daning, and killed its defender Zhu Jian.

sentences.zh: 總兵官劉真、都督陳亨援大寧，亨叛降燕。

translations.literal: Regional commander Liu Zhen and Commander Chen Heng went to relieve Daning; Heng rebelled and surrendered to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Liu Zhen and Regional Commander Chen Heng marched to relieve Daning; Heng turned traitor and joined Yan.

sentences.zh: 燕以寧王權及朵顏三衛卒歸北平。

translations.literal: Yan, with Prince of Ning Zhu Quan and the troops of the three Uriankhai divisions, returned to Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yan brought Prince Ning Zhu Quan and the Uriankhai auxiliaries back to Beiping.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，李景隆重圍北平，燕兵還救。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, Li Jinglong heavily besieged Beiping; Yan's troops returned to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Jinglong pressed Beiping hard; Yan's army wheeled home to its relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，李景隆及燕兵戰於鄭村壩，敗績，奔德州，諸軍盡潰。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the eleventh month, Li Jinglong fought Yan's troops at Zheng Village Dam, suffered defeat, fled to Dezhou, and the armies were wholly routed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the eleventh month Li Jinglong met Yan at Zheng Village Dam, was shattered, fled to Dezhou, and the host dissolved.

sentences.zh: 燕王棣再上書於朝。

translations.literal: Prince of Yan Zhu Di again submitted a memorial to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yan Zhu Di again memorialized the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝為罷齊泰、黃子澄官，仍留京師。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon dismissed Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng from office but kept them at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jianwen dismissed Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng from office yet kept them in the capital.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙寅朔，詔天下來朝官勿賀。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the bingyin new moon of the first month of spring, an edict: officials coming to court from throughout the realm were not to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the bingyin new moon of spring, an edict forbade visiting officials from offering New Year congratulations at court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, the sacrifice was offered to the First Teacher Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the court sacrificed to Confucius as First Teacher.

sentences.zh: 二月，燕兵陷蔚州，進攻大同。

translations.literal: In the second month, Yan's troops took Weizhou and pressed the attack on Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Yan's army took Weizhou and pushed on Datong.

sentences.zh: 李景隆自德州赴援，燕兵還北平。

translations.literal: Li Jinglong set out from Dezhou to the relief; Yan's troops returned to Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jinglong marched from Dezhou to relieve the siege; Yan's forces withdrew to Beiping.

sentences.zh: 保定知府雒僉叛降燕。

translations.literal: Luo Qian, prefect of Baoding, rebelled and surrendered to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Qian, prefect of Baoding, went over to Yan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復以都察院為御史府。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, the Censorate was again made the Office of the Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Censorate was restored as the Office of the Censor.

sentences.zh: 均江、浙田賦。

translations.literal: Land tax in Jiangsu and Zhejiang was equalized.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax in Jiangsu and Zhejiang was brought to a uniform rate.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「國家有惟正之供，江、浙賦獨重，而蘇、松官田悉準私稅，用懲一時，豈可為定則。

translations.literal: The edict said: "The state has its proper revenue; Jiangsu and Zhejiang's levies alone are heavy, while Suzhou and Songjiang official fields are all assessed at private-tax rates—a measure meant for a moment, not to stand as fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: The edict declared: "A realm has its proper dues, yet Jiangsu and Zhejiang alone bear crushing levies; Suzhou and Songjiang assess official fields at private rates—a wartime expedient, not a law for all time.

sentences.zh: 今悉與減免，畝毋逾一斗。

translations.literal: Now all are to be reduced and remitted; per mu let it not exceed one dou.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth all such charges are cut; per mu let the levy not exceed one dou.

sentences.zh: 蘇、松人仍得官戶部。

translations.literal: The people of Suzhou and Songjiang may still obtain official household registration at the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou and Songjiang households may still register as official households with the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 」三月丙寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the bingyin new moon of the third month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon of the third month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 賜胡廣等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Hu Guang and other presented scholars of the jinshi degree and those granted office by seniority were bestowed with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Guang and the other new jinshi, with those passed by seniority, received graded honors.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，李景隆及燕兵戰於白溝河，敗之。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the fourth month of summer, Li Jinglong fought Yan's troops at the White Ditch River and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the fourth month Li Jinglong met Yan's army at White Ditch River and drove it back.

sentences.zh: 明日復戰，敗績，都督瞿能、越巂侯俞淵、指揮滕聚等皆戰死，景隆奔德州。

translations.literal: The next day they fought again; he suffered defeat; regional commander Qu Neng, Yuexi Marquis Yu Yuan, commander Teng Ju, and others all died in battle; Jinglong fled to Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: The next day battle was joined again and he was broken; Commander Qu Neng, Marquis Yu Yuan of Yuexi, Commander Teng Ju, and others fell on the field; Jinglong fled to Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，奔濟南。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the xinwei day, [he] hurried to Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinwei day, Li Jinglong rushed to Jinan.

sentences.zh: 燕兵陷德州，遂攻濟南。

translations.literal: The Yan army captured Dezhou and then attacked Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yan's army took Dezhou and pressed on against Jinan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，景隆敗績於城下，南走。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, Jinglong was defeated below the walls and fled south.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Li Jinglong was routed beneath the city walls and fled south.

sentences.zh: 參政鐵鉉、都督盛庸悉力御之。

translations.literal: Participating Secretary Tie Xian and Commander-in-Chief Sheng Yong exerted all their strength to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: Participating Secretary Tie Xian and Commander-in-Chief Sheng Yong threw everything they had into the defense.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，遣尚寶丞李得成諭燕罷兵。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the sixth month, Palace Storehouse Director Li Decheng was sent to instruct the Yan [prince] to cease hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the sixth month, the court dispatched Palace Storehouse Director Li Decheng to order the Prince of Yan to stand down.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸巳，承天門災，詔求直言。

translations.literal: In autumn, on the guisi day of the eighth month, the Chengtian Gate suffered a fire disaster; an edict sought forthright memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the guisi day, fire ravaged the Chengtian Gate; the throne called for blunt counsel from the officials.

sentences.zh: 戊申，盛庸、鐵鉉擊敗燕兵，濟南圍解，復德州。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Sheng Yong and Tie Xian struck and defeated the Yan army; the siege of Jinan was lifted and Dezhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Sheng Yong and Tie Xian broke the Yan forces, lifted the siege of Jinan, and won Dezhou back.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔錄洪武中功臣罪廢者後。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, an edict ordered that descendants of meritorious officials condemned and dismissed in the Hongwu reign be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, an edict directed that the heirs of Hongwu-era ministers stripped of rank for crimes be restored to the rolls.

sentences.zh: 辛未，封盛庸歷城侯，擢鐵鉉山東布政使，參贊軍務，尋進兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Sheng Yong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Licheng; Tie Xian was promoted to Shandong Administrative Commissioner with a role in military affairs, and soon advanced to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Sheng Yong was created Marquis of Licheng; Tie Xian was raised to Shandong administrative commissioner to assist in the war effort and shortly after made Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 以庸為平燕將軍，都督陳暉、平安副之。

translations.literal: Yong was made General Who Pacifies Yan; Commanders-in-Chief Chen Hui and Ping An served as his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yong was appointed General Who Pacifies Yan, with Commanders-in-Chief Chen Hui and Ping An as his seconds.

sentences.zh: 庸屯德州，平安及吳傑屯定州，徐凱屯滄州。

translations.literal: Yong encamped at Dezhou; Ping An and Wu Jie encamped at Dingzhou; Xu Kai encamped at Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yong held Dezhou; Ping An and Wu Jie held Dingzhou; Xu Kai held Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，召李景隆還，赦不誅。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Li Jinglong was summoned back and pardoned from execution.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Li Jinglong was recalled to court and spared the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 庚申，燕兵襲滄州，徐凱被執。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, the Yan army raided Cangzhou and Xu Kai was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Yan troops stormed Cangzhou and took Xu Kai prisoner.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，燕兵犯濟寧，薄東昌。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the twelfth month, the Yan army attacked Jining and pressed close to Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the twelfth month, the Yan army struck at Jining and closed on Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，盛庸擊敗之。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Sheng Yong struck and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Sheng Yong routed them.

sentences.zh: 斬其將張玉。

translations.literal: Their general Zhang Yu was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan general Zhang Yu was killed in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，復戰，又敗之，燕兵走館陶。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, they fought again; again they were defeated, and the Yan army fled to Guantao.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the armies clashed again; Sheng Yong won again and drove the Yan forces back toward Guantao.

sentences.zh: 庸軍勢大振，檄諸屯軍合擊燕，絕其歸路。

translations.literal: Yong's army's momentum greatly swelled; he issued proclamations to the encamped armies to join in attacking Yan and cut off their line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yong's army took heart; he sent summons to every garrison to close on the Yan forces and sever their retreat.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛酉朔，凝命神寶成，告天地宗廟，御奉天殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: In the third year, on the xinyou new moon of the first month of spring, the Ningming Sacred Seal was completed; Heaven, Earth, and the imperial ancestors were notified; he received court congratulations in the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, at the xinyou new moon of spring's first month, the Ningming Sacred Seal was finished; the court reported to Heaven, Earth, and the imperial ancestors, and the emperor took congratulations in the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，吳傑、平安邀擊燕兵於深州，不利。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Wu Jie and Ping An intercepted the Yan army at Shenzhou; it was unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Wu Jie and Ping An tried to ambush the Yan army at Shenzhou and were beaten back.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，享太廟，告東昌捷。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and announced the victory at Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and proclaimed the triumph at Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 復齊泰、黃子澄官。

translations.literal: Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng were restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng were reinstated in their posts.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，盛庸敗燕兵於夾河，斬其將譚淵。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the third month, Sheng Yong defeated the Yan army at Jiahe and beheaded their general Tan Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the third month, Sheng Yong defeated the Yan army at Jiahe and killed their general Tan Yuan.

sentences.zh: 再戰不利，都指揮庄得、楚智等力戰死。

translations.literal: In renewed fighting it was unfavorable; Commander-in-Chief Zhuang De, Chu Zhi, and others fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fighting that followed, the tide turned; Commander-in-Chief Zhuang De, Chu Zhi, and others sold their lives and fell.

sentences.zh: 壬午，復戰，敗績，庸走德州。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, they fought again; defeated, Yong fled to Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day they met again in battle; Sheng Yong was routed and retreated to Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，都督何福援德州。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, Commander-in-Chief He Fu reinforced Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Commander-in-Chief He Fu marched to relieve Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，貶齊泰、黃子澄、諭燕罷兵。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng were demoted and the Yan [prince] was instructed to cease hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng were cashiered and the Prince of Yan was again ordered to lay down his arms.

sentences.zh: 閏月己亥，吳傑、平安及燕戰於藁城，敗績，還保真定。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the intercalary month, Wu Jie, Ping An, and the Yan army fought at Gaocheng; defeated, they withdrew to defend Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the intercalary month, Wu Jie and Ping An fought the Yan army at Gaocheng, were defeated, and fell back on Zhending.

sentences.zh: 燕兵掠真定、順德廣平、大名。

translations.literal: The Yan army plundered Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, and Daming.
translations.idiomatic: Yan forces looted Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, and Daming.

sentences.zh: 棣上書讀召還諸將息兵，遣大理少卿薛岩報之。

translations.literal: Di submitted a memorial requesting recall of the generals and cessation of hostilities; Junior Counselor of the Court of Judicial Review Xue Yan was sent in reply.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Di sent up a memorial asking that the field generals be recalled and the armies stand down; the court dispatched Junior Counselor of the Court of Judicial Review Xue Yan with a reply.

sentences.zh: 是月，《禮制》成，頒行天下。

translations.literal: That month, the Rites Code was completed and promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Rites Code was finished and issued empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲寅，盛庸以兵扼燕餉道，不克。

translations.literal: In summer, on the jiayin day of the fifth month, Sheng Yong used troops to block the Yan supply route; he did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the jiayin day, Sheng Yong tried to choke the Yan supply lines and failed.

sentences.zh: 棣復遣使上書，下其使於獄。

translations.literal: Di again sent envoys submitting a memorial; his envoys were cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Di sent envoys with another memorial; the court threw his messengers into prison.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，燕將李遠寇沛縣，焚糧艘。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the sixth month, the Yan general Li Yuan raided Pei County and burned the grain barges.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the sixth month, the Yan general Li Yuan struck Pei County and burned the grain fleet.

sentences.zh: 壬午，都督袁宇邀擊之，敗績。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, Commander-in-Chief Yuan Yu intercepted and attacked them; defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Commander-in-Chief Yuan Yu moved to intercept them and was routed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，燕兵掠彰德。

translations.literal: In autumn, on the jichou day of the seventh month, the Yan army plundered Zhangde.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jichou day, Yan troops ravaged Zhangde.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，平安自真定攻北平。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, Ping An advanced from Zhending to attack Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Ping An marched out of Zhending to strike at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大同守將房昭帥兵由紫荊關趨保定，駐易州西水寨。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, the Datong garrison commander Fang Zhao led troops through Zijing Pass toward Baoding and encamped at the Xishuizhai stockade in Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Fang Zhao, garrison commander of Datong, led his men through Zijing Pass toward Baoding and made camp at the Xishuizhai stockade west of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，平安及燕將劉江戰於北平，敗績，還保真定。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day of the ninth month, Ping An and the Yan general Liu Jiang fought at Beiping; defeated, they withdrew to defend Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the ninth month, Ping An and the Yan general Liu Jiang fought at Beiping; beaten, he pulled back to hold Zhending.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，真定諸將遣兵援房昭，及燕王戰於齊眉山，敗績。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the tenth month of winter, the Zhending generals sent troops to reinforce Fang Zhao; they fought the Prince of Yan at Qimei Mountain and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the tenth month of winter, the generals at Zhending sent reinforcements to Fang Zhao; they met the Prince of Yan at Qimei Mountain and were crushed.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，遼東總兵官楊文攻永平，及劉江戰於昌黎，敗績。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, the Liaodong supreme commander Yang Wen attacked Yongping; he fought Liu Jiang at Changli and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, Yang Wen, supreme commander of Liaodong, attacked Yongping; Liu Jiang met him at Changli and broke his army.

sentences.zh: 己亥，平安敗燕將李彬於楊村。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, Ping An defeated the Yan general Li Bin at Yangcun.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Ping An defeated the Yan general Li Bin at Yangcun.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，燕兵焚真定軍儲。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, the Yan army burned the Zhending military stores.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Yan forces burned the military granaries at Zhending.

sentences.zh: 詔中官奉使侵暴吏民者，所在有司系治。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that wherever palace eunuchs on mission oppressed officials and the people, the local authorities were to arrest and try them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded that any palace eunuch on assignment who bullied officials or commoners was to be seized and prosecuted by the local authorities.

sentences.zh: 是月，駙馬都尉梅殷鎮淮安。

translations.literal: That month, the Chief Commandant of Horse Administration Mei Yin garrisoned Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Chief Commandant of Horse Administration Mei Yin took command at Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 《太祖實錄》成。

translations.literal: The Veritable Records of the Taizu Emperor were completed.
translations.idiomatic: The Veritable Records of Emperor Taizu were completed.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲申，召故周王橚於蒙化，居之京師。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, on the jiashen day of the first month of spring, the former Prince of Zhou Su was summoned from Mengzi and lodged in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the jiashen day of spring's first month, the former Prince of Zhou, Zhu Su, was recalled from Mengzi and housed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 燕兵連陷東阿、東平、汶上、兗州、濟陽，東平吏目鄭華，濟陽教諭王省皆死之。

translations.literal: The Yan army in succession captured Dong'e, Dongping, Wenshang, Yanzhou, and Jiyang; Zheng Hua, clerical officer of Dongping, and Wang Sheng, instructor of Jiyang, both died in its defense.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan army overran Dong'e, Dongping, Wenshang, Yanzhou, and Jiyang in turn; Zheng Hua, clerical officer of Dongping, and Wang Sheng, district instructor of Jiyang, died defending their posts.

sentences.zh: 甲申，魏國公徐輝祖帥師援山東。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, the Duke of Wei Xu Huihu led an army to relieve Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Xu Huihu, Duke of Wei, took the field to relieve Shandong.

sentences.zh: 燕兵陷沛縣，知縣顏伯瑋、主簿唐子清、典史黃謙死之。

translations.literal: The Yan army captured Pei County; Magistrate Yan Bowei, Registrar Tang Ziqing, and Clerk Huang Qian died in its defense.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan army took Pei County; Magistrate Yan Bowei, Registrar Tang Ziqing, and Clerk Huang Qian died holding the city.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，薄徐州。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, [they] pressed close to Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the Yan army closed on Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，都督何福及陳暉、平安軍濟寧，盛庸軍淮上。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the second month, Commander-in-Chief He Fu together with Chen Hui and Ping An's armies [were at] Jining; Sheng Yong's army [was] on the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the second month, He Fu joined Chen Hui and Ping An at Jining while Sheng Yong held the line on the Huai.

sentences.zh: 己卯，更定品官勛階。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, the ranks of merit for graded officials were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the court revised the merit ranks for graded officials.

sentences.zh: 三月，燕兵攻宿州，平安追及於淝河，斬其將王真，遇伏敗績，宿州陷。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Yan army attacked Suzhou; Ping An caught up with them at the Fei River, beheaded their general Wang Zhen, met an ambush and was defeated; Suzhou fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Yan army besieged Suzhou; Ping An overtook them on the Fei River, killed their general Wang Zhen, walked into an ambush, and was driven off; Suzhou fell.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，何福、平安敗燕兵於小河，斬其將陳文。

translations.literal: In summer, on the dingmao day of the fourth month, He Fu and Ping An defeated the Yan army at Xiaohe and beheaded their general Chen Wen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingmao day, He Fu and Ping An routed the Yan army at Xiaohe and killed their general Chen Wen.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，徐輝祖等敗燕兵於齊眉山，斬其將李斌，燕兵懼，謀北歸。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, Xu Huihu and others defeated the Yan army at Qimei Mountain and beheaded their general Li Bin; the Yan army was afraid and planned to return north.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Xu Huihu and his colleagues broke the Yan army at Qimei Mountain and killed their general Li Bin; the Yan troops wavered and talked of marching north again.

sentences.zh: 會帝聞訛言，謂燕兵已北，召輝祖還，何福軍亦孤。

translations.literal: Just then the emperor heard a false report and supposed the Yan army had already gone north; he summoned Huihu back, and He Fu's army was left isolated.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the emperor heard a rumor that the Yan army had already withdrawn north; he recalled Xu Huihu, leaving He Fu's force stranded alone.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，諸將及燕兵大戰於靈璧，敗績，陳暉、平安、禮部侍郎陳性善、大理寺卿彭與明皆被執。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, the generals and the Yan army fought a great battle at Lingbi; defeated, Chen Hui, Ping An, Vice Minister of Rites Chen Xingshan, and Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Peng Yuming were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day the loyalist generals met the Yan army in a great battle at Lingbi and were destroyed; Chen Hui, Ping An, Vice Minister of Rites Chen Xingshan, and Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Peng Yuming were all taken.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，楊文帥遼東兵赴濟南，潰於直沾。

translations.literal: On the guwei day of the fifth month, Yang Wen led the Liaodong army toward Jinan and was routed at Zhigu.
translations.idiomatic: On the guwei day of the fifth month, Yang Wen marched the Liaodong army toward Jinan and was shattered at Zhigu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，盛庸軍潰於淮上，燕兵渡淮，趨揚州。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Sheng Yong's army was routed on the Huai; the Yan army crossed the Huai and pressed toward Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Sheng Yong's army broke on the Huai; Yan forces crossed the river and drove on Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 指揮王禮等叛降燕，御史王彬、指揮崇剛死之。

translations.literal: Commander Wang Li and others rebelled and surrendered to Yan; Censor Wang Bin and Commander Chong Gang died in its defense.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Wang Li and others turned traitor and opened the gates to the Yan; Censor Wang Bin and Commander Chong Gang died defending the city.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，燕兵至六合，諸軍迎戰，敗績。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the Yan army reached Liuhe; the armies met them in battle and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the Yan army reached Liuhe; the loyalist forces went out to meet them and were beaten.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔天下勤王，遣御史大夫練子寧、侍郎黃觀、修撰王叔英分道徵兵。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, an edict called the realm to arms for the emperor; Grand Censor Lian Zining, Vice Minister Huang Guan, and Compiler Wang Shuying were sent by separate routes to levy troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, an edict summoned the empire to rise for the throne; Grand Censor Lian Zining, Vice Minister Huang Guan, and Compiler Wang Shuying were dispatched by different routes to raise armies.

sentences.zh: 召齊泰、黃子澄還。

translations.literal: Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng were summoned back.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng were recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 蘇州知府姚善、寧波知府王璡、徽州知府陳彥回、樂平知縣張彥方各起兵入衛。

translations.literal: Yao Shan, prefect of Suzhou; Wang Jin, prefect of Ningbo; Chen Yanhui, prefect of Huizhou; and Zhang Yanfang, magistrate of Leping, each raised troops and marched to the emperor's defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Shan, prefect of Suzhou; Wang Jin, prefect of Ningbo; Chen Yanhui, prefect of Huizhou; and Zhang Yanfang, magistrate of Leping, each mustered local forces and marched to defend the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣慶成郡主如燕師，議割地罷兵。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Princess Qingcheng was sent to the Yan army to negotiate ceding territory and ceasing hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Princess Qingcheng was sent to the Yan camp to bargain for a territorial settlement and a ceasefire.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，盛庸帥舟師敗燕兵於浦子口，復戰不利。

translations.literal: On the guichou day of the sixth month, Sheng Yong led the fleet and defeated the Yan army at Puzikou; in renewed fighting it was unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the sixth month, Sheng Yong led the river fleet and beat the Yan army at Puzikou, then lost the rematch.

sentences.zh: 都督僉事陳瑄以舟師叛附於燕。

translations.literal: Commander Chen Xuan led the fleet in rebellion and attached himself to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Chen Xuan turned the river fleet and went over to the Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，燕兵渡江，盛庸戰於高資港，敗績。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, the Yan army crossed the river; Sheng Yong fought at Gaozigang and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the Yan army crossed the Yangzi; Sheng Yong gave battle at Gaozigang and was routed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，鎮江守將童俊叛降燕。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, the Zhenjiang garrison commander Tong Jun rebelled and surrendered to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Tong Jun, garrison commander of Zhenjiang, defected to the Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，燕兵至龍潭。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, the Yan army reached Longtan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the Yan army reached Longtan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命諸王分守都城，遣李景隆及兵部尚書茹瑺、都督王佐如燕軍，申前約。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, the princes were ordered to guard the capital by separate assignments; Li Jinglong together with Minister of War Ru Yao and Commander Wang Zuo were sent to the Yan army to renew the previous agreement.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the princes were ordered to man separate sectors of the capital; Li Jinglong, Minister of War Ru Yao, and Commander Wang Zuo were sent to the Yan camp to plead the old terms again.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，復遣谷王橞、安王楹往。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, the Prince of Gu Hui and the Prince of An Ying were again sent.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the Prince of Gu, Zhu Hui, and the Prince of An, Zhu Ying, were dispatched as well.

sentences.zh: 皆不聽。

translations.literal: [The Yan prince] would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yan would not hear them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣使齊蠟書四齣，促勤王兵。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, envoys were sent with four copies of wax-sealed letters urging the armies called to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the court sent envoys bearing four wax-sealed summons to hurry the relief armies forward.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，燕兵犯金川門，左都督徐增壽謀內應，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, the Yan army attacked the Jinchuan Gate; Left Commander-in-Chief Xu Zengshou plotted an inside response and was executed in secret.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the Yan army struck the Jinchuan Gate; Left Commander-in-Chief Xu Zengshou plotted to open the walls from within and was quietly put to death.

sentences.zh: 谷王橞及李景隆叛，納燕兵，都城陷。

translations.literal: The Prince of Gu and Li Jinglong rebelled and admitted the Yan army; the capital fell.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Gu and Li Jinglong turned traitor and let the Yan army in; the capital was lost.

sentences.zh: 宮中火起，帝不知所終。

translations.literal: Fire broke out in the palace; the emperor's end was unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Flames swept the palace; no one knew what became of the emperor.

sentences.zh: 燕王遣中使出帝後屍於火中，越八日壬申葬之。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yan sent eunuchs to bring the emperor's remains out from the fire; eight days later, on the renshen day, they were buried.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yan sent eunuchs to recover the emperor's body from the blaze; eight days later, on the renshen day, it was buried.

sentences.zh: 或云帝由地道出亡。

translations.literal: Some say the emperor escaped through a secret tunnel.
translations.idiomatic: Others held that he had slipped away through a hidden passage.

sentences.zh: 正統五年。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of the Zhengtong reign.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 有僧自雲南至廣西，詭稱建文皇帝。

translations.literal: A monk from Yunnan arrived in Guangxi, falsely claiming to be the Jianwen emperor.
translations.idiomatic: A monk came up from Yunnan into Guangxi and pretended to be the Jianwen emperor.

sentences.zh: 恩恩知府岑瑛聞於朝。

translations.literal: Cen Ying, prefect of En'en, reported it to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Ying, prefect of En'en, reported the matter to the throne.

sentences.zh: 按問，乃鈞州人楊行祥，年已九十余，下獄，閱四月死。

translations.literal: On investigation, he was Yang Xingxiang of Junzhou, already more than ninety years old; he was imprisoned and died four months later.
translations.idiomatic: Under interrogation he proved to be Yang Xingxiang of Junzhou, already past ninety; he was thrown into prison and died four months later.

sentences.zh: 同謀僧十二人，皆戍遼東。

translations.literal: Twelve monks who had conspired with him were all banished to Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve monks who had aided the plot were all exiled to Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 自後滇、黔、巴、蜀間，相傳有帝為僧時往來跡。

translations.literal: Afterward, throughout Yunnan, Guizhou, Ba, and Shu, tradition held that traces remained of the emperor's comings and goings when he had been a monk.
translations.idiomatic: After that, across Yunnan, Guizhou, Ba, and Shu, people kept saying they could trace the emperor's wanderings from the years he had lived as a monk.

sentences.zh: 正德、萬曆、崇禎間，諸臣請續封帝後，及加廟諡，皆下部議，不果行。

translations.literal: During the Zhengde, Wanli, and Chongzhen reigns, various ministers requested renewed enfeoffment for the emperor's heirs and the addition of temple honors and posthumous titles; each time the matter was referred to the ministries for discussion and was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhengde, Wanli, and Chongzhen emperors, ministers repeatedly asked that the Jianwen line be enfeoffed again and that temple rites and a posthumous title be granted; each proposal went to the ministries and died there.

sentences.zh: 大清乾隆元年，詔廷臣集議，追諡曰恭閔惠皇帝。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Qianlong reign of the Great Qing, an edict ordered the court ministers to assemble in deliberation and conferred the posthumous title Emperor Gongmin Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign, the Qing court ordered its ministers to convene and bestowed the posthumous title Emperor Gongmin Hui.
